arxiv-1702-04635.title: On the entropic nature of unified interactions
arxiv-1702-04635.creator: Emre Dil, and Tugrul Yumak
arxiv-1702-04635.description: Abstract In this paper, we generalize Verlinde’s entropic gravity proposal on the other fundamental interactions of nature. We begin by introducing the entropic origin of the Coulomb’s electrostatic force, and then the magnetic force, by assuming the holographic principle holds when a charged particle approaches a screen enclosing the emerged part of the spacetime due to a source.

arxiv-1804-07293.title: Anisotropy of the dc conductivity due to orbital-selective spin fluctuations in the nematic phase of iron superconductors
arxiv-1804-07293.creator: Raquel Fernández-Martín, Laura Fanfarillo, Lara Benfatto, Belén Valenzuela
arxiv-1804-07293.description: Abstract We study the DC conductivity of iron-based superconductors within the orbital-selective spin fluctuation scenario. Within this approach, the anisotropy of spin fluctuations below the spin-nematic transition at T s T_{s} is also responsible for the orbital ordering, induced by nematic self-energy corrections to the quasiparticle dispersion.

arxiv-1911-04196.title: Optimizing short stabilizer codes for asymmetric channels
arxiv-1911-04196.creator: Alex Rigby, JC Olivier, Peter Jarvis
arxiv-1911-04196.description: Abstract For a number of quantum channels of interest, phase-flip errors occur far more frequently than bit-flip errors. When transmitting across these asymmetric channels, the decoding error rate can be reduced by tailoring the code used to the channel. However, analyzing the performance of stabilizer codes on these channels is made difficult by the #P-completeness of optimal decoding.

arxiv-2012-01945.title: Budget Constrained Interactive Search for Multiple Targets
arxiv-2012-01945.creator: Xuliang Zhu 1 , Xin Huang 1 , Byron Choi 1 , Jiaxin Jiang 1 , Zhaonian Zou 2 , Jianliang Xu 1
arxiv-2012-01945.description: Abstract . Interactive graph search leverages human intelligence to categorize target labels in a hierarchy, which is useful for image classification, product categorization, and database search. However, many existing interactive graph search studies aim at identifying a single target optimally, and suffer from the limitations of asking too many questions and not being able to handle multiple targets.

arxiv-2105-10072.title: De-Biased Modelling of Search Click Behavior with Reinforcement Learning Conference: Proceedings of the 44th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2021; Virtual Event, Canada Proceedings of the 44th International ACM SIGIR Conference on
arxiv-2105-10072.creator: Jianghong Zhou, Sayyed M. Zahiri, Simon Hughes, Khalifeh Al Jadda, Surya Kallumadi, Eugene Agichtein
arxiv-2105-10072.description: Abstract . Users’ clicks on Web search results are one of the key signals for evaluating and improving web search quality, and have been widely used as part of current state-of-the-art Learning-To-Rank(LTR) models. With a large volume of search logs available for major search engines, effective models of searcher click behavior have emerged to evaluate and train LTR models.

arxiv-2205-02890.title: Magnetic ion relaxation time distribution within a quantum well
arxiv-2205-02890.creator: A. Łopion, A. Bogucki, W. Kraśnicki, K. E. Połczyńska, W. Pacuski, T. Kazimierczuk, A. Golnik, P. Kossacki
arxiv-2205-02890.description: Abstract Time-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) is a valuable technique to study the local deformation of the crystal lattice around magnetic ion as well as the ion spin relaxation time. Here we utilize selective Mn-doping to additionally enhance the inherent locality of the ODMR technique.

arxiv-2311-03389.title: Learning Disentangled Speech Representations
arxiv-2311-03389.creator: Yusuf Brima, Ulf Krumnack, Simone Pika, Gunther Heidemann
arxiv-2311-03389.description: Abstract Disentangled representation learning in speech processing has lagged behind other domains, largely due to the lack of datasets with annotated generative factors for robust evaluation. To address this, we propose SynSpeech, a novel large-scale synthetic speech dataset specifically designed to enable research on disentangled speech representations.

pmc-10640974.title: Editorial: Opportunity costs in health care: cost-effectiveness thresholds and beyond
pmc-10640974.creator: Chris Sampson, Ashley Leech, Borja Garcia-Lorenzo
pmc-10640974.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ivery of health services, opportunity cost remains a slippery concept that can be operationalised for policymaking in numerous ways. One popular approach to thinking about opportunity cost is the cost-effectiveness bookshelf analogy. In this analogy, books represent health technologies, and the opportunity cost of adopting a new technology is represented by the best book that no longer fits on the shelf. Charlton uses this analogy to explore the fairness of restricting access to health care based on its budget impact.

pmc-11428193.title: Design, synthesis, and high-throughput in vitro anti-cancer evaluation of novel 4-aminopyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine derivatives: potential anti-cancer candidates against UO-31 renal cancer cells†
pmc-11428193.creator: Amitananda Dash, Guruswamy Vaddamanu, Mohammed B. Hawsawi, Mustafa S. Alluhaibi, Pavana Kumari Gurijala, Naveen Mulakayala
pmc-11428193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A novel series of 20 compounds containing 4-aminopyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine core were synthesized, characterized and their chemical structures confirmed using spectroscopic techniques such as 1H NMR, 13C NMR, IR, and HRMS. The compound's growth inhibitory activities were evaluated against 60 human tumor cell lines from nine panels: leukemia, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), colon, central nervous system (CNS), melanoma, ovarian, renal, prostate, and breast cancer. Among all the compounds, 11, 12c, 12d, 12f, and 12j are active against different cancer cell lines.

pmc-12546702.title: Research on the spatio-temporal variation of agricultural film usage in China and the effect of threshold crop yield
pmc-12546702.creator: Chengtao Gao, Guiting Mu, Zhenming Zhang, Wenmin Luo
pmc-12546702.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Agricultural films (AGF) are widely used to improve crop yield, conserve soil moisture, and reduce herbicide use, but excessive application has caused substantial soil contamination. Using data from the China Agricultural Statistical Yearbook and the China Environmental Statistical Yearbook, this study systematically examined the spatiotemporal evolution and drivers of AGF usage in China from 1998 to 2022, employing standard deviation ellipse analysis, spatiotemporal statistics, correlation analysis, random forest modeling, and panel threshold modeling.

pmc-12639091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-13257494.creator: Riyadh Alturki, Muhammad Imran Khan
pmc-13257494.description: This study investigates the use of Alkali Bypass Dust (ABD), a cement kiln waste, as a supplementary cementitious material in mortar.
